context.description: Three worker failures in a row fail the unit with a harness error

evidence.trustReason: Given a ready task with the real begin worker failing on git, its supervisor counts the first and second failures with no stored fact. Advancing the simulated retry clock causes a third failure and exactly one task.failed with a harness error prefix and the git message; the fold reaches failed and a later clock advance causes no fourth attempt. A ready scenario batch drives the real scenarioProof worker through three git failures, stores no scenario result after the first two, then stores exactly one scenario.proved failed with the same prefix and error, folds S1 to failed, and does not repeat. A verifying scenario additionally drives the real judge through three tagged WorkerError claim failures and records scenario.verified rejected with the exact harness reason. The lint change only replaces the error type; the message, retry counts, assertions and negative controls remain unchanged.
